svg.title: Background and stack
svg.desc: Krish Naik's AI/ML course, studied up to NLP and still in progress — 27 sections, regression through ensembles and unsupervised learning to NLP, with one project packaged and deployed. His RAG course, up to corrective RAG. Worked with agent harnesses like DeepSeek Harness. Contributed to open-source hackathons with an award-winning Japanese college undergrad. Stack: languages: Python, C / C++, SQL, Java (beginner); ml + data: scikit-learn, NumPy, pandas, SciPy; llm + rag: LangChain, LangGraph, Qdrant, Pinecone, MCP, DeepSeek Harness; web + infra: FastAPI, Flask, React, Vite, Docker, Git

g.text: 27 sections · regression to ensembles to unsupervised to NLP · one project packaged and deployed

Contributed to open-source hackathons with an award-winning Japanese college undergrad.
